value.name: ゆっくり寄る
value.text: The camera slowly pushes in toward the subject.

value.name: ゆっくり引く
value.text: The camera slowly pulls back to reveal the surroundings.

value.name: 左から右へパン
value.text: The camera pans smoothly from left to right.

value.name: 周りを回り込む
value.text: The camera orbits slowly around the subject.

value.name: 固定カメラ
value.text: The camera stays still; only the subject moves.

value.name: 手持ちカメラ
value.text: Handheld camera with slight natural shake.

value.name: アニメ調
value.text: Anime style, clean line art, cel shading, consistent character design.

value.name: 実写・映画風
value.text: Cinematic live-action footage, shallow depth of field, natural lighting.
